# Handoff — Library triaged 84→51, neural-SR pipeline fixed, wraps + Saturn; ALL COMMITTED & PUSHED
Written: 2026-07-24 12:05 · Session: ~50 turns

## Where things stand
Commit `37831d3` is pushed to darthzen/float main — everything from the previous
session (84-scene build, gesture) plus this one (triage to 51 scenes, SR fixes,
immersive wraps) is in. Working tree is clean. Final sim build after the last prune:
BUILD SUCCEEDED. Library: 51 scenes, 51 catalog entries, verified equal.

## Decisions made (and why)
- **There is NO "never upscale past the source" rule — Rick explicitly disavowed it**
  (it self-invented last session and shipped grainy 4000px SPHEREx scenes). Sources
  below the 12288 target are ALWAYS neurally upscaled. Saved to memory
  `upscaling-neural-inference` (correction paragraph).
- **RealESRGAN_x4plus for equirect SR** (`upscale/neural_sr.py`): won a crop A/B vs
  Siax/UltraSharp (worm artifacts on survey noise) and USDU (hue shift + tile seams
  on diffuse regions, 100x slower). Model downloaded onto the pod. USDU diffusion
  recipe stays for flat POTM masters (`master_sr.py`) — device-approved parity.
  Downscaling with Lanczos is fine; the rule governs upscaling only.
- **Pod is a 32 GB V100** (not 16 as previously memorized). Ollama GPU-sharing note
  still applies (scale replicas before big batches).
- **Every API workflow must also exist in the ComfyUI web UI** (Rick's rule, this
  session): `upscale/build_sr_wf_ui.py` emits UI-format JSONs; both current recipes
  are installed in /basedir/user/default/workflows/ (equirect_realesrgan_sr,
  potm_usdu_master_sr).
- **Wide-aspect masters (ar >= 1.9, any class except planet) become wrap-fields**:
  fov = clamp(80*aspect, 180, 270) equidistant, feather .30, exposure .35 — partial
  147–159° wraps still read "cut off" to Rick. Rule lives in `potm_auto_manifest.py`;
  nine scenes re-composed (max: potm2410a at 261°). Halo cap for equidistant is 300°
  (gnomonic keeps 165).
- **Saturn (saturn1) fov 45→95** with ×1.44 USDU SR — "big and majestic" per Rick.
- **Triage flow**: `triage.html` (repo root, gitignored) generated by
  `scripts/make_triage_page.py` — POTM cards show render + archived master; Rick
  marks removals, clicks "Save list" → `~/Downloads/triage_removed*.txt`; then
  `scripts/prune_scenes.py --file <newest>`. Pruned ids lock into
  `upscale/pruned_scenes.json` (manifest regen skips them). Archive on
  `/Volumes/Logic Pro/Float Originals Archive/` is NEVER touched by pruning.
- **master_sr.py poll window is now 60 min** — a 10k-wide USDU output ran past the
  old 16-min window and looked like a failure while the GPU was still working. If an
  SR "fails" with no output, check the pod queue before resubmitting.

## Files touched (all committed in 37831d3)
- `upscale/neural_sr.py` — NEW: RealESRGAN equirect SR, wrap-padded, cached in
  `_raw/_sr_cache/`
- `upscale/process_backdrops.py` — mono_hires always SRs below-target sources; Rick
  added a `spatial_unwise_allsky` row himself (unWISE W1+W2, built at target res)
- `upscale/build_sr_wf_ui.py` — NEW: UI-format workflow emitter
- `upscale/potm_auto_manifest.py` — wrap rule + pruned_scenes skip
- `upscale/deepsky_pipeline.py` — equidistant halo cap 300
- `upscale/master_sr.py` — 60-min poll
- `upscale/deepsky_auto.json` — 32 rows now (41 minus 9 pruned); wrap fovs + saturn 95
- `scripts/make_triage_page.py`, `scripts/prune_scenes.py` — NEW triage tooling
- `upscale/pruned_scenes.json` — 34 pruned ids across 3 rounds
- `Float/Immersive/SpatialImageEnvironment.swift` — 51 entries
- Backdrop/ — 51 HEICs + thumbnails; SPHEREx (stars, full) re-rendered at 12288

## What's verified vs assumed
- VERIFIED: push landed (1624e05..37831d3, GH001 large-file warning only); tree
  clean; sim builds succeeded after every prune round; all SR/compose chains ran
  0-failed; counts 51=51; SPHEREx SR quality checked by crop inspection (clean
  stars, no seams).
- ASSUMED / UNTESTED (needs headset): all nine wraps' feel — especially potm2410a
  (261°) and potm2310a (253°), a face-on galaxy wrapped that far may read oddly;
  Saturn at 95°; SPHEREx grain actually resolved at eye; whether "flat artwork"

  deepspace stereo recipe (depth_floor 0.94) — was deliberately NOT touched).

  45 non-SR POTM originals live ONLY on the archive drive (5 wrap masters were
  copied back into `_raw/potm/`).

Headset pass on the ten re-rendered scenes (nine wraps + Saturn) and the two
re-rendered SPHEREx maps. Tune candidates: per-scene `fov_x` nudges in
`upscale/deepsky_auto.json` then `deepsky_pipeline.py --only <scene> --force`.
Queued behind it: the "flat artwork" root cause — consider a field-specific stereo
recipe with more relief than deepspace's depth_floor 0.94, and/or per-scene exposure

loser); possible 4th triage round.
